comparison.objective: Commission an adjustable damper versus use a reach rod through a guarded port to hold a reset button.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires recessed hex-key work, fine collar rotation, and torque-limited relocking; record requires selecting, grasping, aligning, and cantilevering a long rod through a port.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two safe repeatable carriage stops; record requires a bar at least 50 mm inside, within 12 degrees of horizontal, holding the button at least 5 mm in for one second.
comparison.reason: Physical button actuation is only a minor candidate step; the record's tested ability is remote tool alignment through constrained access. Candidate rebound, overload, and drift thresholds remain undeclared.
